description: Create two links to a visual page of the user's generated posts. ownerLink = full CONTROL: edit each platform's caption (by hand or by AI rewrite), AI-edit / replace / add images, approve, schedule, and publish now (great when chat can't render images, or as a QR on a phone) — share only with people trusted to edit and publish. reviewLink = read-only EXTERNAL APPROVAL: view every platform's caption, leave comments (a thread) and approve or request changes — safe to share with a client or colleague; their feedback notifies the user and shows in their dashboard Reviews tab. Defaults to the latest generation batch.

postId.description: Exact post ID; use for a specific image or video.
